gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the TerraMaster F4-424 Pro ($759.99 at TerraMaster's store today) ships with 32 GB of DDR5, while TerraMaster's own 32 GB stick lists at $699.99. The box is about $60 more than its RAM alone. That works out to $23.75 per GB of installed RAM, against $39.37/GB for the F4-425 Pro (16 GB, one slot) and $77.50/GB for the UGREEN DXP4800 Plus (8 GB).
standout_why: I compared against the two cited pages and Notebookcheck. NASCompares' F4-424 Pro guide (cited) lists 32 GB and a $599–699 price but has no measured power, no per-GB or per-bay arithmetic and no current RAM prices. needtoknowit's UGREEN DXP TrueNAS/Unraid page (cited) has no wattage, running cost or per-bay figures, and its only price is in AUD. Notebookcheck's F4-424 Pro review (shown, not cited) has idle watts for that one model but no annual kWh, no RAM-cost comparison and no other candidates. None of them put today's US store prices next to RAM prices.
decides: It supports the F4-424 Pro as the 4-bay pick for TrueNAS. TrueNAS asks for 8 GB minimum and more for apps and VMs, and every 16 GB a buyer adds costs a lot at today's RAM prices ($469.99 for TerraMaster's 16 GB stick). The F4-424 Pro already has 32 GB in its single slot, so it skips that cost. The F4-425 Pro and DXP4800 Plus are cheaper per bay ($157.50 and $155.00), but they ship with 16 GB and 8 GB. Annual idle energy is close between the F4-424 Pro and DXP4800 Plus at about 209–212 kWh, so power doesn't split them unless the DXP4800 Plus runs on 10GbE (about 267 kWh). Our page also needs its F4-424 Pro price updated from $699.99 to $759.99.
